key_insight: Stochastic transport models connect uncertainty-aware geophysical fluid dynamics with rigorous analysis, data-driven calibration and high-dimensional Bayesian inference.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports uncertainty quantification and forecasting for ocean and other geophysical flows.
method: Develop well-posedness, regularity and approximation theory for stochastic transport equations.
Calibrate stochastic transport structures using observations and high-resolution simulations.
Apply Bayesian data assimilation, particle filters and machine-learning uncertainty quantification.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a synthesis of theoretical and methodological advances, including data-based calibration, but reports no quantitative evaluation results.
watch_item: Practical scalability and forecasting accuracy in high-dimensional applications are not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: From Stochastic Transport Models to High-Dimensional Bayesian Inference
